relationships.name: HAS_ACT
relationships.description: Episode is subdivided into Acts
relationships.prompt_if_source: List the acts that make up {node_name}.

relationships.name: HAS_CHAPTER
relationships.description: Act is subdivided into Chapters

relationships.name: HAS_SCENE
relationships.description: Chapter is subdivided into Scenes

relationships.name: CONTAINS_EVENT
relationships.description: Scene contains one or more Events
relationships.prompt_if_target: In which scene does {node_name} take place?

relationships.name: PRECEDES
relationships.description: Chronological ordering: this event happens before the target

relationships.name: FEATURES_CHARACTER
relationships.description: Characters appearing in a scene

relationships.name: PARTICIPATES_IN
relationships.description: Character participates in an event

relationships.name: MEMBER_OF
relationships.description: Character belongs to a group or faction
relationships.prompt_if_source: What groups or factions is {node_name} affiliated with?

relationships.name: CONTROLS_LOCATION
relationships.description: Group currently controls or governs a place

relationships.name: POSSESSES_PROP
relationships.description: A character currently possesses an object/prop

relationships.name: HAS_TRAIT
relationships.description: Baseline trait of a character

relationships.name: ALTERS_TRAIT
relationships.description: Event changes the polarity or intensity of a trait

relationships.name: ASSIGNED_ARCHETYPE
relationships.description: Character embodies or has been cast into an archetypal role

relationships.name: IN_STATE
relationships.description: Current canonical state of an entity
relationships.prompt_if_source: What is the current state of {node_name}?
relationships.prompt_if_target: Which entities are currently in the state {node_name}?

relationships.name: CHANGES_STATE
relationships.description: Event results in a new state

relationships.description: The originating (subject) character in a relationship edge

relationships.name: RELATIONSHIP_OBJECT
relationships.description: The target character of a relationship edge

relationships.description: Event where the relationship shifts (friends→rivals, etc.)

relationships.description: Characters participating in a conflict

relationships.description: Scene where the conflict visibly surfaces

relationships.name: ESCALATES_INTO
relationships.description: Smaller conflict grows into a larger one
relationships.prompt_if_source: Into which bigger conflicts can {node_name} escalate?

relationships.name: SHIFTED_BY_EVENT
relationships.description: Specific event that pivots the conflict

relationships.name: EXPRESSES_THEME
relationships.description: Narrative element expresses or explores a theme
relationships.prompt_if_target: Which narrative elements express the theme {node_name}?

relationships.name: PERSONIFIES_THEME
relationships.description: Character personifies an abstract idea

relationships.name: CENTRES_ON_CONFLICT
relationships.description: Plot’s defining central conflict

relationships.name: ADVANCES_VIA_EVENT
relationships.description: Key beats that push the plot forward

relationships.description: Element adapted or inspired by earlier material

relationships.name: ADAPTED_INTO
relationships.description: Source material adapted into new narrative assets

relationships.name: VISITED_IN_EVENT

relationships.description: Creation event for an object/prop

relationships.description: Event where the object is destroyed or lost

relationships.name: ALLIED_WITH
relationships.description: Groups formally allied

relationships.name: OPPOSES
relationships.description: Groups in opposition or conflict

relationships.name: COMMANDED_BY
